## Problem and behavior / 问题与行为

Describe the problem, the final behavior, and why this change helps.
说明问题、修改后的行为与原因。

## Related issue / 关联问题

Link the issue, or explain why this is a small standalone change.
填写关联 Issue，或说明这是独立的小改动。

## Verification / 验证

List commands and actual results. State what was not tested. Documentation-only changes may use link/YAML/example checks.
列出实际执行的检查及结果，明确未测范围。纯文档改动可检查链接、YAML 和示例。

## UI or translation evidence / 界面或翻译证据

For UI work, include redacted before/after views and language/appearance coverage. Otherwise write N/A.
界面改动请附脱敏前后对照及语言/主题覆盖，否则填不适用。

## Review checklist / 自查

- [ ] The change is focused; unrelated edits are excluded / 改动聚焦，未混入无关修改
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or missing checks are explained / 相关检查已通过，未测项已说明
- [ ] User-facing text and parameters use localization resources / 可见文案与参数已按需本地化
- [ ] No private captures, work records, credentials, certificates, or generated app/ZIP files / 无私人截图、工作记录、凭据、证书或生成包
- [ ] Dependency/license/privacy changes are documented if applicable / 依赖、许可证及隐私影响已按需说明
